description: This file defines the NativeToolCallParser class, which handles parsing, processing, and managing streaming chunks of native tool calls, including support for dynamic MCP tools, partial JSON parsing, and conversion of API file entries. It facilitates converting raw API chunks into structured ToolUse or McpToolUse objects for tool invocation within a larger system.

classes.name: NativeToolCallParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods to process raw chunks of tool call data from API streams, manage streaming state, parse arguments (including partial JSON), and convert API file entries into structured formats. It supports dynamic MCP tools and maintains internal state for ongoing tool calls.

methods.name: processRawChunk
methods.description: Processes a raw chunk of tool call data, manages tracking, buffering, and emits start/delta/end events.

methods.name: processFinishReason
methods.description: Emits end events for all tracked tool calls when the stream finish reason indicates completion.

methods.name: finalizeRawChunks
methods.description: Finalizes any remaining raw chunks, emitting end events for unclosed tool calls.

methods.name: clearRawChunkState
methods.description: Clears all raw chunk tracking state, typically called at the start of a new API request.

methods.name: startStreamingToolCall
methods.description: Initializes tracking for a new streaming tool call with given id and name.

methods.name: clearAllStreamingToolCalls
methods.description: Clears all ongoing streaming tool call states.

methods.name: hasActiveStreamingToolCalls
methods.description: Checks if there are any active streaming tool calls.

methods.name: processStreamingChunk
methods.description: Processes a JSON chunk for a streaming tool call, returning a partial ToolUse object.

methods.name: finalizeStreamingToolCall
methods.description: Finalizes a streaming tool call, parsing the complete arguments into a ToolUse or McpToolUse.

methods.name: convertFileEntries
methods.description: Converts raw API file entries with various line range formats into structured FileEntry objects.

methods.name: createPartialToolUse
methods.description: Creates a partial ToolUse object from parsed arguments for ongoing streaming updates.

methods.name: parseToolCall
methods.description: Converts a raw tool call object into a structured ToolUse or McpToolUse, handling normalization and validation.

methods.name: parseDynamicMcpTool
methods.description: Parses dynamic MCP tool calls with names like mcp--server--tool, returning McpToolUse objects.
